title: Publisher boundary and tenant search
scope: Authenticate publisher separately and version resource upserts.
Maintain normalized locale metadata and explicit fallback.
Implement tenant/project resources search with authorized views and bounded cursor pagination.
Enforce current grant policy on report configuration creation and retrieval.
invariants: Publication does not create entitlement or grant.
Resource identity is stable across languages and versions.
view=entitled requires management authority; default view=granted enforces consumer policy.
Saved report references cannot bypass current access.

acceptance.given: Publisher updates several locales in one payload
acceptance.then: one identity remains and localizations update atomically without modifying customer access

acceptance.given: Publisher reuses a stale version or idempotency key with a different payload
acceptance.then: 409; current catalog and existing customer grants remain unchanged
fallback is explicit or a missing-metadata state renders; grants are unchanged

acceptance.given: Customer queries a term matching only another organization
acceptance.then: empty authorized result and no unauthorized total/count

acceptance.given: A viewer requests entitled management view
A revoked resource remains in a saved report reference
acceptance.when: that report configuration is fetched or used
acceptance.then: current grant policy denies the protected content

acceptance.given: Publisher archives while resource use runs
acceptance.then: use observes a consistent published/archived boundary and no grant is invented

acceptance.when: a newer publication attempts to republish it
acceptance.then: 409 terminal_resource_state with no content or grant changes; replacement requires a new stable key
